reasons.A: Long, smoothly joined explanatory sentences with hedged, essayistic transitions; none of the passage's clipped fragments or plain confiding stance.
reasons.B: Right short declaratives, no contractions and quiet close, but stacks fragments and signposting ('Here is the rest of the job', 'Then the pressure. Then the heat.') more thickly than the passage, tipping into caricature.
reasons.C: Closest movement: short declaratives and fragments mixed with occasional mid-length sentences, the passage's blend of imperative and first-person, uncontracted plain diction and a low-key ending.
